core_obligations: Reduce to the open locus: for a locally finite type morphism there is a maximal open subspace over which it is locally quasi-finite, whose formation commutes with representable base change, so it suffices to show that the point lies in it (proof lines 4265-4273)

Apply the criterion: the base-changed morphism is locally of finite type and of relative dimension zero at the point by hypothesis, so the corresponding criterion for algebraic spaces makes it locally quasi-finite there (proof lines 4274-4279)
proof_roadmap: 对局部有限型态射有「局部拟有限的最大开子空间 W(f)」，其形成与可表示基变换交换。
只需证该点在 W(f) 中；而 F → Spec(k) 局部有限型且 dim_z(F) = 0 ⇒ 由「相对维数 0 ⇒ 局部拟有限」得在该点局部拟有限。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a morphism which is locally of finite type and whose fibre over a field has dimension zero at a point becomes locally quasi-finite after shrinking the source to an open subspace containing that point (author lemma at source lines 4247-4263, label lemma-quasi-finite-at-point). The proof (source lines 4265-4280) uses the maximal open subspace on which the morphism is locally quasi-finite and its compatibility with base change to reduce to the relative dimension criterion (proof lines 4265-4279). The reduction through the maximal locally quasi-finite locus is the substance. H3.
